Trace, implement and test: Rotation Left Right

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
package Problems_on_Arrays;

public class RotationLeftRight {
    public static void Rotatetoleft(int[] arr, int n, int k) {
        if (n == 0)
            return;
        k = k % n;
        if (k > n)
            return;
        int[] temp = new int[k];
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            temp[i] = arr[i];
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n - k; i++) {
            arr[i] = arr[i + k];
        }
        for (int i = n - k; i < n; i++) {
            arr[i] = temp[i - n + k];
        }
    }

    public static void main(String args[]) {
        int n = 7;
        int[] arr = { 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 };
        int k = 2;
        Rotatetoleft(arr, n, k);
        System.out.println("After Rotating the elements to left ");
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            System.out.print(arr[i] + " ");
        }
    }

}
